subject: Medisphere: Renewal + Private VPC expansion — onboarding & capacity amendment
messages:
From: Samantha Cole <samantha@medisphere.io>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com
Cc: Procurement Team <contracts@medisphere.io>, Ivan Petrov <ivan@cloudops-consulting.com>
Date: 2027-02-20T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal & Private VPC expansion — initial ask

Hi Kimberly,

Hope you’re well. Our renewal for Redwood is coming up in late March and our platform team is planning to expand the private/VPC footprint across two additional regions. High-level asks: add a new isolated environment for analytics (dedicated clusters), explicit IP allowlist options for cross-region replication, and updated term to support a 24-month reserved commitment if we can get a meaningful capex-equivalent discount.

We need the following to move procurement quickly: a draft amendment or SOW we can circulate, a pricing band for the additional capacity (ballpark first is fine), and any SOC2/attestation evidence for vendor review. I’ve attached our network diagram for the proposed topology and a short procurement checklist.

Can we set a short kickoff next week to line up technical and legal owners? Ivan (cc’d) will help with the network questions.

Appreciate it —
Samantha Cole
Head of Cloud Ops, Medisphere Health
samantha@medisphere.io
(415) 555-0184

Attachments referenced: NetworkDiagram.png (internal topology), Medisphere-Procurement-Checklist.docx

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: Samantha Cole <samantha@medisphere.io>
Cc: michael.grant@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com, Ivan Petrov <ivan@cloudops-consulting.com>
Date: 2027-02-21T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & Private VPC expansion — initial ask

Samantha — thanks for the context and diagram, that helps.

High-level plan:
- Kickoff call to align technical owners + procurement: propose Thurs 2027-02-24 10:00 PT.
- I'll draft an amendment + SOW that covers: scope (new isolated analytics environment), cluster counts, ingress/egress IP rules, monitoring/backup retention, and an optional term bump to 24 months.
- Need estimates from your team: expected steady-state RPS for analytics endpoints, average tokens per request during peak, and whether logs/residency must stay in-region.

Cc’ing Michael (pricing) and Neha (deploy ops) to size clusters and propose pricing ranges. I’ll attach a draft SOW and a pricing worksheet after we sync internally.

Next steps: please confirm the kickoff slot or suggest alternatives and share the procurement contact name for DocuSign routing.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

--

On Sat, Feb 20, 2027 at 9:14 AM Samantha Cole <samantha@medisphere.io> wrote:
> [original message and attachments omitted here for thread brevity]

From: michael.grant@redwood.com
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-22T08:47:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: Medisphere sizing + proposal notes

Kim / Neha — quick internal notes before the client kickoff. Please do not forward this internal-only email to Medisphere.

Sizing recommendation (rough):
- New analytics environment: 2 dedicated clusters (gpu-heavy), each cluster with 4 reserved inference workers (NVIDIA A100 equivalents) to support bursty analytic workloads. Assume 25% KV cache reuse from existing workloads.
- Autoscale policy: maintain baseline of 2 workers per cluster, burst to 4 during peak windows.

Commercials and term:
- Offer two options: 12-month add-on at list price; 24-month commit with 15% committed-cap discount + one-time migration credit equal to one month of reserved capacity to offset integration work.
- Include an onboarding services line-item (one-time) to cover network tests and certificate exchange.

Docs: I’ll draft pricing bands and recommend we attach a short SOC2 attestation excerpt to speed procurement.

Michael Grant
Director, Solutions Pricing — Redwood Inference
michael.grant@redwood.com

From: kimberly.park@redwood.com
To: Samantha Cole <samantha@medisphere.io>, Procurement Team <contracts@medisphere.io>, Ivan Petrov <ivan@cloudops-consulting.com>
Cc: michael.grant@redwood.com, neha.kapoor@redwood.com
Date: 2027-02-24T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Proposed amendment & SOW for private environment expansion (draft)

Samantha — following internal sizing, please find our proposed highlights and attached drafts. I’m including Michael and Neha for any follow-ups.

Summary of proposal (high level):
- Scope: Add one new isolated analytics environment in us-west-2 with two clusters; each cluster 4 reserved inference nodes; baseline autoscale 2->4 workers.
- Term options: 12-month add-on at list; 24-month commit with 15% capacity discount and one-month migration credit.
- Onboarding: one-time services fee to cover network validation, cert exchange, and DR test (estimate attached).
- Security & compliance: we will provide SOC 2 attestation excerpt and the network allowlist procedure; Redwood will deliver audit logs for the added environment with 90-day retention by default (extendable).

Attached: SOW_v2.pdf (draft amendment + technical appendix), PricingSheet.xlsx (pricing bands and optional term scenarios), NetworkDiagram.png (client-provided).

Action items for Medisphere:
1) Confirm preferred term (12 vs 24) and procurement contact for DocuSign.
2) Confirm RPS and peak token estimates (we used conservative numbers but can re-size).
3) Review network allowlist in appendix and confirm IP ranges or request help from Ivan.

Proposed next steps: once you confirm term preference we’ll generate a formal amendment and send DocuSign link. If everything looks good I’ll schedule a technical kickoff with Neha and Ivan for next week.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.com

Attachments: SOW_v2.pdf, PricingSheet.xlsx

From: Samantha Cole <samantha@medisphere.io>
To: kimberly.park@redwood.com, procurement <contracts@medisphere.io>
Cc: Ivan Petrov <ivan@cloudops-consulting.com>
Date: 2027-02-28T16:35:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Proposed amendment & SOW for private environment expansion (draft)

Kim — thanks for the quick turnaround and the clear deck. Procurement has started review and legal has a couple of minor redlines for the onboarding SLA window. We prefer the 24-month commitment for the discount and migration credit, but procurement has one ask: can the onboarding services fee be amortized across the first three invoices rather than invoiced up-front?

Also:
- Please include a copy of your SOC 2 attestation (the excerpt you mentioned) and the certificate so we can pass it to internal audit.
- Technical kickoff: Thu 2027-03-04 09:00 PT works for Ivan and our platform team.
- Small network change: we will add a /29 to the allowlist in addition to the ranges in the appendix; Ivan will send the exact IP.

Procurement contact for DocuSign: Michelle Park <michelle.park@medisphere.io> (cc’d in procurement). Once we have the updated invoice schedule and the SOC2 copy we’ll queue signatures.

Appreciate the help — looking forward to the kickoff.

Samantha Cole
Head of Cloud Ops, Medisphere Health
samantha@medisphere.io
